posts.text: Feeling blessed at the Somnath Temple as we celebrate 75 years of the consecration of Lord Mahadev's idol. This temple stands as a symbol of India's civilisational resilience and the spirit of reconstruction that defined our freedom.
posts.caption: Feeling blessed at the Somnath Temple as we celebrate 75 years of the consecration of Lord Mahadev's idol. This temple stands as a symbol of India's civilisational resilience and the spirit of reconstruction that defined our freedom.

posts.text: PM Shri @narendramodi participated in Somnath Amrut Mahotsav, marking 75 years since the inauguration of the restored Somnath Temple, Gujarat. He performed Mahapuja and Kumbhabhishek at the temple.
posts.caption: PM Shri @narendramodi participated in Somnath Amrut Mahotsav, marking 75 years since the inauguration of the restored Somnath Temple, Gujarat. He performed Mahapuja and Kumbhabhishek at the temple.

posts.text: Addressed the Lok Sabha on the government's unwavering commitment to reservation, representation and delimitation. Our Constitution guarantees justice for all. Under PM Modi's leadership, we have expanded and protected these rights like never before.
posts.caption: Addressed the Lok Sabha on the government's unwavering commitment to reservation, representation and delimitation. Our Constitution guarantees justice for all. Under PM Modi's leadership, we have expanded and protected these rights like never before.

posts.text: India's national interests are being compromised. The people deserve transparency on the Adani case, on data sovereignty, and on our dependence on foreign oil. The government cannot silence accountability by threatening privilege notices.
posts.caption: India's national interests are being compromised. The people deserve transparency on the Adani case, on data sovereignty, and on our dependence on foreign oil. The government cannot silence accountability by threatening privilege notices.

posts.text: Uttar Pradesh continues to set new benchmarks in governance, development and law and order. Our state is becoming a model of progress under PM Modi's vision of a Viksit Bharat.
posts.caption: Uttar Pradesh continues to set new benchmarks in governance, development and law and order. Our state is becoming a model of progress under PM Modi's vision of a Viksit Bharat.

posts.text: The people of Delhi know who works for them. AAP will continue to fight for free electricity, water, education and healthcare for every citizen. No amount of political vendetta can stop our mission.
posts.caption: The people of Delhi know who works for them. AAP will continue to fight for free electricity, water, education and healthcare for every citizen. No amount of political vendetta can stop our mission.

posts.text: Congratulations to FM Dr. Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh on his election as President of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly. Look forward to working closely with him to advance our shared priorities and strengthen multilateral cooperation.
posts.caption: Congratulations to FM Dr. Khalilur Rahman of Bangladesh on his election as President of the 81st Session of the United Nations General Assembly. Look forward to working closely with him to advance our shared priorities and strengthen multilateral cooperation.

posts.text: Budget 2026 lays a clear path for India's growth momentum: 12.2 lakh crore in infrastructure, 7 high-speed rail corridors, carbon capture technology, and city economic regions. Structural reforms and technology adoption will keep India firmly on a high-growth trajectory.
posts.caption: Budget 2026 lays a clear path for India's growth momentum: 12.2 lakh crore in infrastructure, 7 high-speed rail corridors, carbon capture technology, and city economic regions. Structural reforms and technology adoption will keep India firmly on a high-growth trajectory.

posts.text: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. From ports to airports, green energy to data centres, the Adani Group remains committed to building the foundation of a Viksit Bharat. Our nation's potential is limitless.
posts.caption: India's infrastructure story is accelerating. From ports to airports, green energy to data centres, the Adani Group remains committed to building the foundation of a Viksit Bharat. Our nation's potential is limitless.

posts.text: India's digital transformation journey is just beginning. With Jio's AI-first platform and our giga-factory investments in green energy, we are building for a self-reliant, sustainable India. The best is yet to come for India's entrepreneurs.
posts.caption: India's digital transformation journey is just beginning. With Jio's AI-first platform and our giga-factory investments in green energy, we are building for a self-reliant, sustainable India. The best is yet to come for India's entrepreneurs.

posts.text: If you want to walk fast, walk alone. But if you want to walk far, walk together. India's greatest strength lies in its people, their resilience, and their ability to dream beyond boundaries.
posts.caption: If you want to walk fast, walk alone. But if you want to walk far, walk together. India's greatest strength lies in its people, their resilience, and their ability to dream beyond boundaries.

posts.text: Extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Somnath Amrut Mahotsav. India's civilisational heritage is a source of pride and unity. It is our collective responsibility to preserve and celebrate the values that define our great nation.
posts.caption: Extended greetings to the nation on the occasion of Somnath Amrut Mahotsav. India's civilisational heritage is a source of pride and unity. It is our collective responsibility to preserve and celebrate the values that define our great nation.

posts.text: They've already agreed they're not going to have a nuclear weapon. I think this will resolve itself fairly quickly. We had a very productive call with Netanyahu and a very good call with Hezbollah. All shooting will stop.
posts.caption: They've already agreed they're not going to have a nuclear weapon. I think this will resolve itself fairly quickly. We had a very productive call with Netanyahu and a very good call with Hezbollah. All shooting will stop.

posts.text: The Conservative Party must continue championing enterprise, low taxes and strong borders. Our values of aspiration and opportunity are what Britain needs for the future.
posts.caption: The Conservative Party must continue championing enterprise, low taxes and strong borders. Our values of aspiration and opportunity are what Britain needs for the future.

posts.text: The America First agenda isn't a slogan, it's a governing philosophy. We need to shrink the federal bureaucracy, unleash nuclear energy, and restore merit to every institution. That is how we win.
posts.caption: The America First agenda isn't a slogan, it's a governing philosophy. We need to shrink the federal bureaucracy, unleash nuclear energy, and restore merit to every institution. That is how we win.

posts.text: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom and stave off summer learning loss. Prizes and friendly competition will add to the fun.
posts.caption: I'm thrilled to bring back my Summer Reading Challenge for another year! The challenge will help kids fall in love with reading outside the classroom and stave off summer learning loss. Prizes and friendly competition will add to the fun.

posts.text: Honoured to speak at Bitcoin 2026 on the intersection of federal policy, free speech and the right to build great software in America. Open-source development and digital rights are core to our values.
posts.caption: Honoured to speak at Bitcoin 2026 on the intersection of federal policy, free speech and the right to build great software in America. Open-source development and digital rights are core to our values.

posts.text: The AI policy landscape is evolving rapidly. My focus as White House AI and Crypto Advisor remains ensuring America leads in AI innovation while building responsible frameworks that do not stifle the builders.
posts.caption: The AI policy landscape is evolving rapidly. My focus as White House AI and Crypto Advisor remains ensuring America leads in AI innovation while building responsible frameworks that do not stifle the builders.

posts.text: The World Bank is focused on making development finance work faster and at greater scale. Climate, infrastructure and digital inclusion are one integrated challenge we must solve together.
posts.caption: The World Bank is focused on making development finance work faster and at greater scale. Climate, infrastructure and digital inclusion are one integrated challenge we must solve together.

posts.text: 10 years on from the Brexit referendum, we have got to look forward, not backwards. A stronger, closer relationship with Europe is in the UK's best interest, particularly in a world as volatile as it is. We must also strengthen our relationship with America.
posts.caption: 10 years on from the Brexit referendum, we have got to look forward, not backwards. A stronger, closer relationship with Europe is in the UK's best interest, particularly in a world as volatile as it is. We must also strengthen our relationship with America.

posts.text: Australia stands firmly with the Quad partners for a free, open and resilient Indo-Pacific. Our commitment to regional stability and a rules-based order is unwavering.
posts.caption: Australia stands firmly with the Quad partners for a free, open and resilient Indo-Pacific. Our commitment to regional stability and a rules-based order is unwavering.

posts.text: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting to keep the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran war ends. Europe must take more responsibility for its own defence. SoftBank's 75 billion euro investment in France proves our AI ambitions are real.
posts.caption: France and the UK will co-chair the next meeting to keep the Strait of Hormuz open after the Iran war ends. Europe must take more responsibility for its own defence. SoftBank's 75 billion euro investment in France proves our AI ambitions are real.

posts.text: The UAE continues to build for tomorrow. Our investments in AI, renewable energy and space technology are our contribution to humanity's shared future. Excellence has no ceiling.
posts.caption: The UAE continues to build for tomorrow. Our investments in AI, renewable energy and space technology are our contribution to humanity's shared future. Excellence has no ceiling.

posts.text: Tesla, SpaceX, xAI. All building towards making humanity multiplanetary and superintelligent. The SpaceX IPO roadshow starts next week. Also, X is the best platform for real-time information. Period.
posts.caption: Tesla, SpaceX, xAI. All building towards making humanity multiplanetary and superintelligent. The SpaceX IPO roadshow starts next week. Also, X is the best platform for real-time information. Period.

posts.text: We launched a business AI agent on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. It will eventually help you run your whole business. Customer questions, appointments, sales, market research. A massive increase in entrepreneurship is coming.
posts.caption: We launched a business AI agent on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger. It will eventually help you run your whole business. Customer questions, appointments, sales, market research. A massive increase in entrepreneurship is coming.

posts.text: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. It is lighting up every part of our business. Since launching Gemini 3, our momentum has accelerated. Google's generative AI revenue grew nearly 800 percent year-over-year. We just announced an 80 billion dollar equity raise to scale our investments.
posts.caption: AI is the most profound platform shift of our lifetimes. It is lighting up every part of our business. Since launching Gemini 3, our momentum has accelerated. Google's generative AI revenue grew nearly 800 percent year-over-year. We just announced an 80 billion dollar equity raise to scale our investments.

posts.text: Welcome to Microsoft Build 2026! The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is a dream machine. I am on the wait list too. Together with Nvidia, we are reinventing the personal computer for the era of AI. Agentic AI is here, and we are making it safe for every business.
posts.caption: Welcome to Microsoft Build 2026! The Surface RTX Spark Dev Box is a dream machine. I am on the wait list too. Together with Nvidia, we are reinventing the personal computer for the era of AI. Agentic AI is here, and we are making it safe for every business.

posts.text: In Washington this week advocating for smart AI regulation. We should increase funding for AI testing at the Commerce Department, but requiring government approval before releasing new models would be the wrong approach. Innovation cannot wait for bureaucracy.
posts.caption: In Washington this week advocating for smart AI regulation. We should increase funding for AI testing at the Commerce Department, but requiring government approval before releasing new models would be the wrong approach. Innovation cannot wait for bureaucracy.

posts.text: All systems glow. WWDC 2026 kicks off June 8. We cannot wait to show you what we have been building. iPhone 17 demand has been off the charts. See you next Monday!
posts.caption: All systems glow. WWDC 2026 kicks off June 8. We cannot wait to show you what we have been building. iPhone 17 demand has been off the charts. See you next Monday!

posts.text: Over the last few years, AI learned to generate. Then it learned to reason. Now it can do useful work. Vera Rubin is in full production. RTX Spark plus DGX Station for Windows. Together with Microsoft, we are reinventing the personal computer. Useful AI has arrived. Tokens are profitable. Compute is revenues.

posts.text: India processed 23.2 billion UPI transactions in May 2026, processing 29.90 lakh crore rupees. That is roughly 30 percent of Visa's annual volume in a single month, on infrastructure that did not exist before 2016. India's digital public infrastructure is a model for the world.

posts.text: The AI revolution is real and it is moving faster than most people realise. But we also need to make sure this technology benefits everyone, not just the wealthiest countries. That is where the Gates Foundation is focused: global health, education and equity in the AI era.
posts.caption: The AI revolution is real and it is moving faster than most people realise. But we also need to make sure this technology benefits everyone, not just the wealthiest countries. That is where the Gates Foundation is focused: global health, education and equity in the AI era.

posts.text: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental, it is operational. IBM's hybrid cloud and AI solutions are helping businesses move from proof of concept to production at scale. The real transformation is just beginning.
posts.caption: Enterprise AI is no longer experimental, it is operational. IBM's hybrid cloud and AI solutions are helping businesses move from proof of concept to production at scale. The real transformation is just beginning.

posts.text: Creativity and AI are not competing forces. They amplify each other. Adobe's mission is to give every creator, designer and marketer superpowers through intelligent tools. The creative economy is expanding, not shrinking.
posts.caption: Creativity and AI are not competing forces. They amplify each other. Adobe's mission is to give every creator, designer and marketer superpowers through intelligent tools. The creative economy is expanding, not shrinking.

posts.text: Building in the AI space now. The best technology should serve people transparently and earn trust through results, not promises. Excited about what lies ahead.
posts.caption: Building in the AI space now. The best technology should serve people transparently and earn trust through results, not promises. Excited about what lies ahead.

posts.text: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity paired with technology. Our commitment to craftsmanship and innovation continues to define luxury for the modern world. Empowering women creators remains at the heart of everything we do.
posts.caption: At Chanel, we believe in the power of human creativity paired with technology. Our commitment to craftsmanship and innovation continues to define luxury for the modern world. Empowering women creators remains at the heart of everything we do.

posts.text: At FedEx, we are leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. Our investments in autonomous delivery and intelligent supply chains are creating a more connected and efficient world for businesses everywhere.
posts.caption: At FedEx, we are leveraging AI and data to transform global logistics. Our investments in autonomous delivery and intelligent supply chains are creating a more connected and efficient world for businesses everywhere.

posts.text: Back-to-back champions! 75 not out in the final. There is no better feeling than winning it for RCB and our incredible fans. Now it is time for India duty. ODI series against Afghanistan starts June 13. The chase for 100 centuries continues.
posts.caption: Back-to-back champions! 75 not out in the final. There is no better feeling than winning it for RCB and our incredible fans. Now it is time for India duty. ODI series against Afghanistan starts June 13. The chase for 100 centuries continues.

posts.text: Looking forward to the ODI series against Afghanistan. Every match for India is an opportunity to contribute. The road to the 2027 World Cup starts now. Form is temporary, class is permanent.
posts.caption: Looking forward to the ODI series against Afghanistan. Every match for India is an opportunity to contribute. The road to the 2027 World Cup starts now. Form is temporary, class is permanent.

posts.text: The beauty of cricket lies in the journey, not just the destination. Proud to see the next generation carrying the torch forward. India's cricket is in safe hands.
posts.caption: The beauty of cricket lies in the journey, not just the destination. Proud to see the next generation carrying the torch forward. India's cricket is in safe hands.

posts.text: Resting and recovering ahead of the England tour. Workload management is key in a packed schedule. Supporting the boys from home as they take on Afghanistan. Will be back stronger.
posts.caption: Resting and recovering ahead of the England tour. Workload management is key in a packed schedule. Supporting the boys from home as they take on Afghanistan. Will be back stronger.

posts.text: Great IPL season done. Now it is India colours. Named in the ODI squad for Afghanistan. Fitness is key and I am ready to go. Cannot wait to represent the nation again.
posts.caption: Great IPL season done. Now it is India colours. Named in the ODI squad for Afghanistan. Fitness is key and I am ready to go. Cannot wait to represent the nation again.

posts.text: What a season of IPL it was! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking campaign reminds me of the hunger young talent brings. 15 years old and 5 individual awards. The future of Indian cricket is incredibly bright.
posts.caption: What a season of IPL it was! Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's record-breaking campaign reminds me of the hunger young talent brings. 15 years old and 5 individual awards. The future of Indian cricket is incredibly bright.

posts.text: India vs Afghanistan Test starts June 6 in Mohali. Shubman Gill leading the side, a young captain for a new era. Good to see India investing in the next generation while the experienced players gear up for the ODIs.
posts.caption: India vs Afghanistan Test starts June 6 in Mohali. Shubman Gill leading the side, a young captain for a new era. Good to see India investing in the next generation while the experienced players gear up for the ODIs.

posts.text: Squads announced for the one-off Test and 3-match ODI series against Afghanistan. Test: June 6-10 at Mohali, Captain Shubman Gill. ODIs: June 14, 17, 20 at Dharamshala, Lucknow, Chennai. Bumrah rested for workload management.
posts.caption: Squads announced for the one-off Test and 3-match ODI series against Afghanistan. Test: June 6-10 at Mohali, Captain Shubman Gill. ODIs: June 14, 17, 20 at Dharamshala, Lucknow, Chennai. Bumrah rested for workload management.

posts.text: India begin their post-IPL international season with a Test against Afghanistan in Mohali starting June 6, followed by ODIs. The road to the 2027 World Cup in Africa is well underway!
posts.caption: India begin their post-IPL international season with a Test against Afghanistan in Mohali starting June 6, followed by ODIs. The road to the 2027 World Cup in Africa is well underway!

posts.text: What a season! RCB win back-to-back titles. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi sweeps 5 individual awards at just 15 years old: Orange Cap with 776 runs, MVP, Emerging Player, Super Striker at a strike rate of 237.30, and Most Sixes with 72, breaking Gayle's record. IPL 2026 was one for the ages!
posts.caption: What a season! RCB win back-to-back titles. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi sweeps 5 individual awards at just 15 years old: Orange Cap with 776 runs, MVP, Emerging Player, Super Striker at a strike rate of 237.30, and Most Sixes with 72, breaking Gayle's record. IPL 2026 was one for the ages!

posts.text: Training hard and staying focused as the Diamond League season continues. Every throw is a step towards defending my Olympic gold. The javelin does not lie. It rewards discipline and belief.
posts.caption: Training hard and staying focused as the Diamond League season continues. Every throw is a step towards defending my Olympic gold. The javelin does not lie. It rewards discipline and belief.

posts.text: Consistency is the hardest part of being an elite athlete. Continuing to push limits on the court and preparing for the biggest tournaments ahead. India's badminton story is far from over!

posts.text: Retirement taught me that the love for the game never fades. Watching the next generation of Indian women in sport is incredibly fulfilling. Keep pushing boundaries. Representation matters.

posts.text: Tough competition at Norway Chess 2026 but staying resilient. Won the Armageddon against Wesley So. Patience made the difference. Every game at this level is a battle of nerves and preparation. The World Champion title drives me to keep improving.
posts.caption: Tough competition at Norway Chess 2026 but staying resilient. Won the Armageddon against Wesley So. Patience made the difference. Every game at this level is a battle of nerves and preparation. The World Champion title drives me to keep improving.
